snippet.title: Trailmarks Trailer 1 - Play as a Spy
snippet.description:
You're the new fact-checker for the Trailmarks Travel Guide. Your job: Answer trivia, verify facts and circumnavigate the globe before time and money run out. Travel by boat, bus, train, or flight. Trade exotic souvenirs. Impress your handlers. Keep your spirits up and try not to get stranded.

Trailmarks is coming to PC and Mac on Steam, March 4th 2026
